verdict.rationale: The IRS does document its own system-to-system channels that can run unattended. MeF accepts XML transmissions, and IRIS offers an Application-to-Application intake for information returns. Both are gated behind credentialed enrollment: Authorized e-file Provider status (up to 45 days, possible fingerprinting) or a Transmitter Control Code. The consumer-facing flows cannot be automated: IRS online services require an ID.me biometric liveness check, the EIN assistant has business-hours and session limits, and the online Form 15620 entry returned HTTP 403 to an agent. Missing for 10: an openly accessible API or CLI for general users, a published OpenAPI spec, headless access to the EIN, 83(b) and online-account flows without a human liveness step, and independent corroboration of CI-style usage.
